
The shell and local navigation stay stable while the canvas and decision rail
select one of three modes from governed facts. The mode is a pure function of
those facts; nothing persists or selects it, and no query parameter changes
it.

| Mode | Selection rule | Primary job |
|---|---|---|
| Editorial decision | the object is an intake candidate | read the dossier, audit the recommendation, decide |
| Approved launch | promotion created the project and no Enter Research decision exists | confirm accountability, outputs, review requirements, working surfaces, automation authority |
| Operations | every other project | coordinate focus, deliverables, reviews, delivery evidence, people and agents |

The backbone stores no promotion or Enter Research fact yet, so every project
is in Operations today; the pill under the project key says so, with the basis
"Existing Worklode project; no intake lifecycle facts are present". The
Sunstone stage is derived from governed decisions and work (WL-SPEC-75) and is
an orientation; adjacent-stage work overlaps and stays visible.
